IC1: Patients with histologically [AND] confirmed diagnosis of prostate cancer [OR] who have not yet developed bone metastases
IC2: Prostate cancer [AND] patients with a rise in PSA under hormone therapy.
IC4: Patients who have undergone prostatectomy [AND]: any rise in PSA or
IC5: Patients without prostatectomy: 2 consecutive rises in PSA levels relative to a previous reference value, separated by one month. The first [AND] measurement must occur one month after the reference value and must be above the reference value. The second [AND] confirmatory measurement taken one month after the first measurement must be greater than the first measurement.
IC6: Previous chemotherapy [OR] or radiotherapy must have been performed ≥ 8 weeks prior to study entry.
IC7: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) score of 0, 1 or 2 (patients that spend less than 50% of time in bed during the day)
IC8: Adequate liver function - serum total bilirubin concentration less than 1.5 x upper limit of normal value
IC10: Patient has given written informed consent prior to any study-specific procedures. Patients with psychiatric [OR] or addictive disorders which [NOT] prevent them from giving their informed consent must not enter the study.
